sql: SELECT order_id, amount FROM sales.orders WHERE TO_DATE(created_at) = '2026-01-15'
SELECT order_id FROM sales.orders_2025 UNION SELECT order_id FROM sales.orders_2026
SELECT event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM analytics.events GROUP BY event_date
SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT * FROM sales.orders ORDER BY created_at) t WHERE status = 'PAID'

SELECT a.region, a.total, b.total FROM (SELECT region, SUM(amount) total FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY region) a JOIN (SELECT region, SUM(amount) total FROM sales.orders WHERE status = 'PAID' GROUP BY region) b ON a.region = b.region
SELECT o.order_id, c.name FROM sales.orders o, crm.customers c WHERE o.amount > 100
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.name FROM crm.customers c JOIN sales.orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT o.order_id, (SELECT MAX(p.paid_at) FROM sales.payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.order_id) AS last_paid FROM sales.orders o
SELECT customer_id FROM crm.customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM crm.churned)
SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM crm.customers GROUP BY country HAVING country = 'NG'
SELECT o.order_id, s.status FROM sales.orders o JOIN ops.shipments s ON CAST(o.order_id AS VARCHAR) = s.order_ref
